method: Independent source-only visual review of labeled native-pixel enlargements with full-page music context. Primer pages establish four-shape identities. Boxes are approximate native-pixel head bounds around the labeled centers. No outputs/reference data consulted.

candidates.rationale: The surviving oval is supported by its rounded contour and staff position. A broad segment of its left rim is absent or reduced to disconnected flecks, exceeding an ordinary hollow counter or staff overlap.

Rounded hollow head identity is clear. A definite portion of the outer rim is broken, though the surviving contour makes the missing share appear below one quarter; severity differs from main's severe estimate.
The outer oval contour has a large discontinuity on the upper-left side, beyond the normal interior counter and staff-line crossings. Lost rim appears approximately one quarter or more.

A triangular notehead is supported by the surviving sloped edge and filled base. The diagonal contour/body is interrupted, but the remaining connected mass looks below the severe missing-body threshold.
A substantial part of the triangle's left body/leg and connecting contour is absent; only separated top and lower-right portions remain. This exceeds a normal triangular point or staff overlap.

The diamond outline has a clear lower-left contour break with about a quarter of the expected rim absent. Surviving top and right edges preserve identity; the opening is outside the normal hollow counter.

A broad lower/side segment of the diamond rim is missing around the intact central counter; the remaining angular contour and staff position support diamond identity. I agree with main's approximate quarter-rim loss judgment.
The hollow diamond is reduced to separated upper-left and lower-right outline fragments with a missing connecting contour, meeting the severe fragmented-rim definition.

disagreements.reason: I judge the visible missing outer-rim length below the approximate one-quarter severe threshold.

limitations: Severity remains a visual approximation. Staff crossings and the normal hollow counter were excluded from damage; no reconstruction from another edition was used.
No page-wide candidate ranking or intact controls were established in this bounded review.
